cases.summary: User can open Performance from the main dashboard
cases.preconditions: Logged in on staging with EnvConfig inventory agent (PDV) after PIN validation
cases.input: 1. Open Performance Dashboard from Main Dashboard.
cases.expected: Performance Dashboard is reachable from Main Dashboard, subject to profile/accreditation.
cases.traceability: SAA-913; REQ-001, REQ-002; Access — Main Dashboard

cases.summary: User can open Performance from My Profile
cases.preconditions: Logged in on staging with EnvConfig inventory agent (PDV) after PIN validation
cases.input: 1. Open My Account / My Profile. 2. Open Performance Dashboard.
cases.expected: Performance Dashboard is reachable from My Profile.
cases.traceability: SAA-913; REQ-001; Access — My Profile

cases.summary: Team Leader can select the four dashboard types
cases.preconditions: Logged in as Team Leader
cases.input: 1. Open Performance. 2. Observe the selection screen.
cases.expected: Team Leader can select Registration & Customer Services, Airtime and Bundle Sales, Reload, Team Performance.
cases.traceability: SAA-913; REQ-003; Dashboard Entry Rules — Team Leader

cases.summary: Non-TL non-Reseller can select Registration and Airtime only
cases.preconditions: Logged in as a profile that is not Team Leader and not Reseller
cases.expected: Selection offers Registration & Customer Services and Airtime and Bundle Sales only.
cases.traceability: SAA-913; REQ-004; Other Profiles except Team Leader and Reseller

cases.summary: Reseller is redirected to Reload Dashboard with no selection screen
cases.preconditions: Logged in as Reseller
cases.expected: No selection screen. User is redirected directly to Reload Dashboard.
cases.traceability: SAA-913; REQ-005; Reseller

cases.summary: Dashboards are available only for accredited features
cases.preconditions: User accredited for a subset of registration / airtime / reload / team
cases.expected: Customer Registration & Certification, Airtime, Reload, Team Performance appear only for the accredited features listed in the ticket table.
cases.traceability: SAA-913; REQ-006; Available MVP Dashboards

cases.summary: Period filters Today / This Week / This Month with previous-period logic
cases.preconditions: On a Performance dashboard with KPIs
cases.input: 1. Filter Today. 2. This Week. 3. This Month.
cases.expected: Today compares with Yesterday. This Week with Previous Week. This Month with Previous Month.
cases.traceability: SAA-913; REQ-007; Dashboard Period Filters

cases.summary: History can be filtered by transaction category and certification status
cases.preconditions: History records exist
cases.input: 1. Filter by transaction category. 2. Filter by certification status where applicable.
cases.expected: History filters by transaction category and, where applicable, certification status.
cases.traceability: SAA-913; REQ-008; History Filters

cases.summary: Registration KPIs are displayed
cases.preconditions: Accredited for registration; KPI data present
cases.expected: Shows total registrations, registration target, previous period, certified, ongoing, rejected, Gross Add at D+1, GA Target.
cases.traceability: SAA-913; REQ-009; Registration KPIs Displayed

cases.summary: History includes Registration, SIM Swap, Re-identification, Upgrade Customer File
cases.preconditions: Same-period transactions of those types
cases.expected: Those four types can appear. Each record shows Transaction ID, date and time, certification status Certified / Ongoing / Rejected.
cases.traceability: SAA-913; REQ-010; History Includes / History Details

cases.summary: Rejected history shows reason and Upgrade Customer File
cases.preconditions: A rejected customer file in history
cases.expected: Rejection reason is shown. Upgrade Customer File button redirects to the upgrade flow.
cases.traceability: SAA-913; REQ-011; If rejected

cases.summary: Opening a registration-family transaction shows the stated fields
cases.preconditions: A Registration / SIM Swap / Re-identification / Upgrade File record
cases.expected: Shows transaction name, Transaction ID, date and time, certification status, rejection reason if applicable, Need Help.
cases.traceability: SAA-913; REQ-012; Transaction Details – Registration / SIM Swap / Re-identification / Upgrade File

cases.summary: Rejected file upgrade pre-fills the customer number
cases.preconditions: Rejected customer file
cases.expected: Upgrade flow opens with customer number pre-filled.
cases.traceability: SAA-913; REQ-013; For rejected customer files

cases.summary: Airtime KPIs and history details
cases.preconditions: Accredited for airtime; sales exist
cases.input: 1. Open Airtime dashboard. 2. Open a history row.
cases.expected: KPIs: total volume sold, target, previous period (airtime includes bundle). History: airtime and bundle sales with date/time, customer MSISDN, top-up/bundle, cost, commission if applicable.
cases.traceability: SAA-913; REQ-014, REQ-015; Airtime Dashboard

cases.summary: Airtime / bundle transaction details
cases.preconditions: An airtime or bundle transaction
cases.expected: Shows Airtime Top-up or Bundle Subscription, Transaction ID, date/time, customer MSISDN, amount credited, bundle name if applicable, commission if applicable, Need Help.
cases.traceability: SAA-913; REQ-016; Transaction Details – Airtime / Bundle

cases.summary: Reload KPIs and history types
cases.preconditions: Accredited for reload
cases.expected: KPIs for airtime and mobile money volume (total, target, previous). History includes Airtime, Mobile Money, Scratch Card, SIM Card reloads with date/time, Agent MSISDN, product and amount, transaction cost.
cases.traceability: SAA-913; REQ-017, REQ-018; Reload Dashboard

cases.summary: Reload received vs sent details
cases.preconditions: A reload received and a reload sent record
cases.input: 1. Open Reload Received. 2. Open Reload Sent.
cases.expected: Received shows reseller name and MSISDN who sent. Sent shows agent name and MSISDN who received. Both show name Reload Received/Sent, Transaction ID, date/time, product and amount, total cost, Need Help.
cases.traceability: SAA-913; REQ-019; Transaction Details – Reload

cases.summary: Need Help on a reload offers hotline and the quoted question
cases.preconditions: On a reload transaction detail
cases.expected: Hotline is available and dials the configured number. Question: "Do you have an issue with this transaction?" Options: Issue with SIM card, scratch card or device received; Other, write directly to help centre. Submitted claim is shared with Back Office.
cases.traceability: SAA-913; REQ-020; Claims from Reload Transaction

cases.summary: Team Leader / Supervisor KPIs and active-agent rule
cases.preconditions: Logged in as Team Leader or Supervisor
cases.expected: KPIs: active/inactive agents, reload or registration performance by profile, active agents target, previous period, plus dashboard-type KPIs. Agent is active if they completed at least one App or USSD transaction in the selected period.
cases.traceability: SAA-913; REQ-021; Team Performance Dashboard

cases.summary: Supervisor / Reseller team dashboard history restrictions
cases.preconditions: Logged in as Supervisor
cases.input: 1. Open team dashboard. 2. Attempt to open a detailed transaction.
cases.expected: History includes working days and the four reload types. Supervisor can view agent activity history and cannot view detailed transaction history.
cases.traceability: SAA-913; REQ-022; Supervisor / Reseller Team Dashboard

cases.summary: Team Leader registration dashboard KPIs
cases.preconditions: Logged in as Team Leader on registration dashboard
cases.expected: Total active agents, target, previous; total registrations, target, previous; certified, ongoing, rejected.
cases.traceability: SAA-913; REQ-023; Team Leader Registration Dashboard

cases.summary: Team Leader can view a selected agent's dashboard but not details or upgrade
cases.preconditions: Team Leader with at least one agent in the team
cases.input: 1. Select an agent. 2. Attempt to open a transaction. 3. Attempt Upgrade Customer File.
cases.expected: Shows agent name, MSISDN, Active/Inactive. KPIs match that agent's personal dashboard. History shows type, ID, date/time, certification, rejection reason. Team Leader cannot open transaction details and cannot upgrade customer file from this view.
cases.traceability: SAA-913; REQ-024, REQ-025; View Selected Agent Dashboard

cases.summary: Telco Sales target section is removed
cases.preconditions: On Telco Sales / Airtime area
cases.input: 1. Look for a Target section in Telco Sales.
cases.expected: Target section in Telco Sales is not present.
cases.traceability: SAA-913; REQ-001; Target section in Telco Sales will be removed
